environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). AWS WAFv2 WebACL is associated with the ALB. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes the CrossSiteScripting_BODY, CrossSiteScripting_QUERYARGUMENTS, CrossSiteScripting_COOKIE, and CrossSiteScripting_URIPATH rules. Additionally, the managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' is attached in BLOCK mode. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Note: the application still constructs HTML manually and the code-level vulnerability remains, but WAFv2 inspects query string parameters for XSS patterns before requests reach the application. WAF logging is enabled to CloudWatch Logs with sampled requests visible in the WAF console. The ALB does NOT add Content-Security-Policy headers.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
